ModMetaData.name: [CAP] RICS addon for Chat bots
ModMetaData.author: Captolamia
ModMetaData.description:
Optional addon for [CAP] Rimworld Interactive Chat Service (RICS).
Adds moderator-level bot-only commands that return structured gamestate data for an external AI chatbot (e.g. Masie). Responses are intended for the RICS AI command path (file/HTTP) — not for public viewer chat.
Commands: !botstate, !botpawns, !botthreats, !botmap, !botwealth, !botresources, !botgear
Requires RICS. Load after RICS. DEV/Beta packageId: Captolamia.RICS.Beta | Release: Captolamia.RICS
GitHub: https://github.com/ekudram/cap-RICS-Chatbot-Addon License: AGPLv3
